description: Reviewed deviations between implemented SA 2026 bindings and the committed exact-target inventory, checked by ExactTargetEvidenceCrossCheckTests (#272). Each entry suppresses exactly one finding (command, argument, implemented binding, kind); stale entries fail the test. 'pending_271' holds the 25 step-text differences (13 punctuation/spacing, 12 letter-case) that #271 corrects; when #271 merges, empty that array (or delete the key).
